why: The plane-wave code missed the 0.2 eV bar on polymorph energies (pw-fixed), so per the agreed stop-loss Bl₂Px₃ goes to bands on the ionic model's structure. pwcheck.mjs bands: the SCF, then non-self-consistent bands in its potential along Γ → each zone face and the far corner, and on a Γ-centred grid for the band edges and the DOS (the earlier runs' shifted grids never sampled Γ, where corundum's gap sits; sandbox check: the bands at Γ give back the SCF's gap to every digit). Calibration first: our corundum at ×1.00 against PySCF with the same functional (exchange-only LDA, now reporting its gap) and measured 8.8 eV. Then Bl₂Px₃'s two cells the plane-wave code can't tell apart (z2-0, z2-1, 0.09 eV): if their gaps agree in kind, the structure question stops mattering for the laser case.

groups.name: cal-ours
cmds: node four/atom/tools/pwcheck.mjs bands four/atom/tools/crystalref-Al2O3.json corundum 1.00 40 a18 4

groups.name: bl-z2-0
cmds: node four/atom/tools/pwcheck.mjs bands four/atom/tools/crystalref-Bl2Px3.json z2-0 1.00 25 a10 4 soft
